title: VA Home Loans in Veterans Pension Net Worth
content:
# A VA home loan in the redetermined Veterans Pension net worth

In the redetermination of net worth on a Veterans Pension award, a VA Home Loan Guaranty loan the veteran holds is subtracted by what it secures. The test reads the loan's status, whether occupancy of the home is certified, the partial claim balance owed and the unpaid principal balance:

| Loan status | Veteran occupies the home (occupancy certified) | Partial claim owed | Subtracted from net worth |
|---|---|---|---|
| active | yes | none | nothing — the home itself is excluded |
| active | yes or no | a balance is owed | only the partial claim balance |
| any other combination | — | — | its unpaid principal balance |

**Clause.** When the loan is active on the home the veteran occupies and no partial claim is owed, nothing is subtracted, because the home itself is excluded; when the loan is active and a partial claim is owed, only the partial claim balance is subtracted; otherwise its unpaid principal balance is subtracted.

## Hypothetical loans (unpaid principal balance 140000.00)

- Active, occupancy certified, no partial claim: 0 subtracted.
- Active, occupancy certified, partial claim balance 8500.00: 8500.00 subtracted.
- Active, occupancy not certified, no partial claim: 140000.00 subtracted.
- Paid off or otherwise not active, with an unpaid principal balance shown of 0.00: 0.00 subtracted, the unpaid principal balance being nil.
